name: Magnetosheath Draped Field Line Generation
definition: Generates draped field line samples within the magnetosheath. Field lines are seeded at random positions between the magnetopause and the bow shock, restricted to the dayside (x > -5 R_E). The magnetosheath field model provides the local field vector.
summary: Magnetosheath Draped Field Line Generation seeds lines randomly in the dayside magnetosheath to capture draped solar wind topology, unlike methods tracing from ionospheric footpoints.
